issue.body:
Hello.

I noticed that if I create any exception handlers for my custom exceptions, they are only called if they reside in the same file as the Starlette app initialization.
If i create a separate, let's say `exception_handlers.py`, file and import the Starlette app there, the handling methods are never called.

Is this intented? Am I doing something wrong?
issue.title: Custom Exception Handlers aren't called
